scope: Focused file-read/response-close observations; no additional source-unit approvals
observations: Generic CTAP file segments demand exactly n bytes. apdu_output rejects negative reads, overreads and zero progress with remaining data, clears the source and emits zero bytes/6900.
U2F register returns the number of bytes copied, including any registration prefix; positive short progress can be retried by generic APDU output. This differs from generic CTAP exact-file segments.

Native HID APDU response reads require the exact requested count even for a U2F source. Native MSG/CBOR fault executions return HID ERROR7F and permit a subsequent source probe and full verified recovery.

Rust Storage::read_at is exact-or-error; crates/ffi/src/platform/storage.rs::read_at validates the native count through io_count(Some(out.len())). The test supplies a short prefix then reports an error; no physical/native storage failure is claimed.

The separate C fault build renames only fs.c read_file, then forwards normal operations to that original implementation. The compiled applets/transports are unmodified pinned C. No source/cleanup/authorization result is substituted.
unresolved: T18/E58: three NFC U2F short-read schedules succeed with verified signatures in C and fail closed in Rust. Do not count as parity or an approved intentional production difference.
